metadata.title: Legislative Committees of India
metadata.description: Structured reference data for parliamentary and state legislative committees.
notes: Committee membership and composition may change between terms.
State committee structures differ across States and Union Territories.
State-level entries are reference templates, not assertions that every State has each committee.

committees.name: Public Accounts Committee
committees.purpose: Examines the appropriation accounts, annual finance accounts and reports of the Comptroller and Auditor General of India.
functions: Examines whether money granted by Parliament has been spent within the scope of the grant.
Examines expenditure against parliamentary authorisation.
Considers CAG audit findings referred to it.
Reports irregularities, financial control weaknesses and instances of waste or excess expenditure.

composition.selection: Members are elected by the respective Houses through proportional representation by means of the single transferable vote.
composition.minister_membership: A Minister cannot be elected as a member.

chairperson.convention: Since 1967, the chairperson has conventionally been appointed from the Opposition.

limitations: Does not examine the wisdom of policy underlying expenditure.
Its recommendations are not equivalent to judicial orders.

legal_basis.type: Rules of Procedure and parliamentary practice
references: Rules of Procedure and Conduct of Business in Lok Sabha

committees.name: Estimates Committee
committees.purpose: Examines budget estimates and suggests improvements in economy, efficiency and administrative organisation.
functions: Suggests economies consistent with policy objectives.
Recommends improvements in administrative organisation.
Examines whether money is well laid out within the limits of policy.
Suggests alternative policies that may improve efficiency and economy.
Recommends improvements in the form in which estimates are presented to Parliament.

composition.selection: Members are elected by Lok Sabha through proportional representation by means of the single transferable vote.
composition.minister_membership: A Minister cannot be elected as a member.

limitations: Members are drawn only from Lok Sabha.
Does not examine the detailed accounts of public undertakings in the same manner as the Public Accounts Committee.

legal_basis.type: Rules of Procedure and parliamentary practice
references: Rules of Procedure and Conduct of Business in Lok Sabha

committees.name: Committee on Public Undertakings
committees.purpose: Examines the reports and accounts of specified public undertakings and considers their performance and management.
functions: Examines reports and accounts of public undertakings.
Examines CAG reports relating to public undertakings.
Reviews whether public undertakings are managed in accordance with sound business principles and prudent commercial practices.
Examines matters referred to it under the applicable rules.

composition.selection: Members are drawn from both Houses under the applicable parliamentary procedure.
composition.minister_membership: A Minister cannot be elected as a member.

limitations: Does not examine matters assigned to other parliamentary committees.
Its examination is subject to the committee's prescribed jurisdiction.

legal_basis.type: Rules of Procedure and parliamentary practice
references: Rules of Procedure and Conduct of Business in Lok Sabha

committees.name: Department-related Standing Committees
committees.purpose: Provide detailed parliamentary scrutiny of the work of Union ministries and departments.
functions: Consider demands for grants of the concerned ministries and departments.
Examine Bills referred to the committee.
Consider annual reports of the concerned ministries and departments.
Examine national policy documents referred to them.

composition.selection: Members are nominated by the Speaker of Lok Sabha and the Chairman of Rajya Sabha in accordance with the applicable procedure.

chairperson.appointed_by: Speaker of Lok Sabha or Chairman of Rajya Sabha, depending on the committee.

limitations: Does not consider matters relating to day-to-day administration.
Does not ordinarily consider matters which are under consideration by another parliamentary committee.

legal_basis.type: Rules of Procedure and parliamentary practice
references: Rules of Procedure and Conduct of Business in Lok Sabha
Rules of Procedure and Conduct of Business in Rajya Sabha

committees.name: Business Advisory Committee of Lok Sabha
committees.purpose: Recommends the allocation of time for government and other business in the House.
functions: Recommends time allocation for legislative and other business.
Considers matters relating to the scheduling of House business.
Helps organise the work of the House.

composition.membership: Speaker and members nominated under Lok Sabha rules

references: Rules of Procedure and Conduct of Business in Lok Sabha

committees.name: Business Advisory Committee of Rajya Sabha
committees.purpose: Recommends the time to be allocated for government and other business in Rajya Sabha.
functions: Recommends time allocation for business.
Considers the organisation and scheduling of House business.

composition.membership: Chairman and members nominated under Rajya Sabha rules

references: Rules of Procedure and Conduct of Business in the Council of States

committees.name: Rules Committee of Lok Sabha
committees.purpose: Considers matters relating to the rules of procedure and conduct of business of Lok Sabha.
functions: Considers amendments to the Rules of Procedure.
Examines procedural questions referred to it.

composition.membership: Speaker and members nominated under Lok Sabha rules

committees.name: Rules Committee of Rajya Sabha
committees.purpose: Considers matters relating to the rules of procedure and conduct of business of Rajya Sabha.
functions: Considers amendments to the Rules of Procedure.
Examines procedural matters referred to it.

composition.membership: Chairman and members nominated under Rajya Sabha rules

committees.name: Committee of Privileges
committees.purpose: Examines questions involving breach of privilege and contempt of the House referred to it.
functions: Examines matters referred by the House or its presiding officer.
Determines the facts and circumstances of an alleged breach.
Makes recommendations to the House.

composition.membership: Members nominated under the rules of the respective House

chairperson.appointed_by: Presiding officer of the respective House

limitations: The committee makes recommendations; the House retains the relevant decision-making authority.

committees.name: Committee on Petitions
committees.purpose: Considers admissible petitions presented to the respective House.
functions: Examines petitions referred to it.
Considers the issues raised in petitions.
Recommends action or remedial measures where appropriate.

composition.membership: Members nominated under the rules of the respective House

committees.name: Committee on Subordinate Legislation
committees.purpose: Examines whether powers to make rules, regulations, orders and other subordinate legislation have been properly exercised.
functions: Examines whether delegated legislative powers are exercised within the scope of the parent Act.
Considers whether rules impose an unauthorised tax or other burden.
Examines whether subordinate legislation requires retrospective effect or contains unusual provisions.
Considers whether publication and laying requirements have been followed.

composition.membership: Members nominated under the rules of the respective House

committees.name: Committee on Government Assurances
committees.purpose: Reviews assurances, promises and undertakings given by Ministers on the floor of the House.
functions: Identifies assurances given by Ministers.
Reviews progress in fulfilling assurances.
Examines reasons for delay or non-implementation.

composition.membership: Members nominated under the rules of the respective House

committees.name: Committee on Ethics
committees.purpose: Examines ethical conduct and matters referred under the applicable rules and directions.
functions: Considers complaints or matters relating to members' conduct.
Examines alleged violations of the applicable code of conduct.
Makes recommendations to the House.

composition.membership: Members nominated under the rules or directions of the respective House

committees.name: Committee on Private Members' Bills and Resolutions
committees.purpose: Assists in organising and examining the business relating to Private Members' Bills and resolutions.
functions: Classifies Private Members' Bills and resolutions.
Recommends allocation of time for their discussion.
Considers procedural and scheduling matters relating to this business.

composition.membership: Members nominated under Lok Sabha rules

committees.name: Joint Committee of Parliament
committees.purpose: Examines a specified subject, Bill or matter referred to it by Parliament.
functions: Examines the matter specified in the motion or resolution constituting it.
Takes evidence where authorised.
Submits a report with findings and recommendations.

chairperson.determined_by: Constituting motion or applicable parliamentary decision

committees.term: Until completion of assigned work or as otherwise specified

committees.name: Select Committee
committees.purpose: Examines a Bill referred to a committee of the House concerned.
functions: Examines the provisions of the referred Bill.
May take evidence or invite views as permitted.
Reports its recommendations to the House.

composition.membership: Members of the House referring the Bill

committees.term: Until submission of its report or as specified by the House

committees.name: State Public Accounts Committee
committees.purpose: Examines State expenditure and audit reports of the Comptroller and Auditor General relating to the State.
functions: Examines State appropriation accounts.
Considers State finance accounts and relevant audit findings.
Reviews whether expenditure was authorised and properly applied.

composition.membership: Determined by the rules and practice of the State Legislature

chairperson.determined_by: Relevant State House rules and practice

committees.name: State Estimates Committee
committees.purpose: Examines State budget estimates and considers economy and efficiency in public expenditure.
functions: Examines estimates referred to it.
Suggests improvements in economy and efficiency.
May recommend administrative or policy improvements within its mandate.

composition.membership: Determined by the rules and practice of the State Legislature

committees.name: State Committee on Public Undertakings
committees.purpose: Examines the performance, accounts and audit findings relating to State public undertakings where constituted.
functions: Examines accounts and reports of covered public undertakings.
Considers relevant CAG audit findings.
Reviews management and financial performance within its mandate.

committees.name: State Committee of Privileges
committees.purpose: Examines questions of breach of privilege referred under the rules of the relevant House.
functions: Examines matters referred by the House or presiding officer.
Reports findings and recommendations.

committees.name: State Committee on Petitions
committees.purpose: Considers petitions presented to the relevant State House and referred under its rules.
functions: Examines admissible petitions.
Considers matters raised by petitioners.
Makes recommendations within its mandate.

committees.name: State Committee on Subordinate Legislation
committees.purpose: Examines rules and other subordinate legislation made under State laws, where such a committee is constituted.
functions: Examines whether delegated powers have been exercised within the parent law.
Reviews procedural compliance and other matters prescribed by State rules.

committees.name: State Committee on Government Assurances
committees.purpose: Reviews assurances and undertakings given by State Ministers in the House, where such a committee is constituted.
functions: Tracks assurances given by Ministers.
Reviews implementation and delays.
Reports matters requiring attention.
